text: American Express Company is a NYSE-listed bank holding company with no state or state-fund shareholder. Its single largest shareholder is Berkshire Hathaway Inc. (Warren Buffett), holding about 22.1% as of the 2026 proxy statement; the remaining float is institutional and retail, with Vanguard (6.8%) and BlackRock (6.4%) the next-largest holders.
